description: Header file defining the AudioDecoderPassthrough class, which implements a passthrough audio decoder that creates DecodedAudio objects from input buffers without actual decoding, used in passthrough playback scenarios.

classes.name: AudioDecoderPassthrough
classes.description: A passthrough audio decoder that creates DecodedAudio objects from input buffers without decoding, used for passthrough playback.

methods.name: AudioDecoderPassthrough
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decoder with samples per second.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with output and error callbacks.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Processes input buffers to produce DecodedAudio objects, passing them to the output callback.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream by pushing an empty DecodedAudio object.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the next DecodedAudio object and outputs the samples per second.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, clearing internal buffers.
